_doc: MCApps feature clip – starter config (feature-clip skill). Paths are relative to this file. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Run pnpm voice-meta after every change.
name: SLUG
_maxSeconds: 60 by default. Raise only when the user asks for a longer clip – and keep it concise.
_variant: ONE variant per clip. captions (default): numbered step captions. checklist: step list on the left – only for tutorials with several clear sections, each with several notes. Output is SLUG.mp4 either way.
_theme: Choose per clip (references/themes.md) and say why here. spotlight suits MCApps' dense tables: one thing at a time, the rest dims.

capture._css: Hides the yellow task banner, external-issue banners and the red TESTMILJØ dev footer. Dev-only «Patch OK» toasts are hidden in capture/steps.mjs (real toasts may be part of the clip).
